comingLast.roast: the presentation table has two blue reasons he cannot slip away
averaging 1.0 a hole - the blue balls are warming up
4 holes left to avoid the double blue - 4 points does it
3 points buys freedom - Forsyth is pricing it higher by the minute
3 from 4 - do it for the car keys
still swinging on 20 - hope dies on the 18th, usually
on 20 with 4 to play - even the cart girl knows the equation
escape requires 1 over the last 3 - his mates have started filming
needs 1 point from his last 3 to hand the blue balls to Forsyth
safe-ish by 5 - the blue balls have come back from further
